useWhen: Persistent regional information, warnings, or announcements.
avoidWhen: Use ToastProvider for action results and field hint/error APIs for validation.
composition: Compose an action when there is a specific next step; keep flush banners to one line.
accessibility: State the intent in text, not color alone.

avoidWhen: Use Link for navigation and IconButton for icon-only actions.
accessibility: Give the action a clear text label; preserve disabled and loading behavior.

avoidWhen: Use Button when the action needs a visible text label.
accessibility: The label prop is required and supplies the tooltip and accessible name.

useWhen: Choose one option from a known list.
avoidWhen: Use RadioGroup for a short visible choice set or Typeahead to type and search or create options.
composition: Supply options or groups, and onChange; controlled open also requires onOpenChange.
accessibility: Provide an accessible name using aria-label.
Select.example: <Select aria-label="Region" options={[{ value: 'us', label: 'US' }]} value={region} onChange={setRegion} />

useWhen: Choose one option from a short visible set.
avoidWhen: Use Select for a known option list in a compact picker or RadioCard for supporting content.
composition: Compose labeled RadioButton options inside RadioGroup; own controlled value and onValueChange.
accessibility: Give the group an accessible name and label every option.
RadioGroup.example: <RadioGroup aria-label="Region" value={region} onValueChange={setRegion}><RadioButton value="us" label="US" /><RadioButton value="eu" label="EU" /></RadioGroup>

avoidWhen: Use Pane for substantial editing or detail work.
composition: Compose DialogContent inside Dialog; own open and onOpenChange. The application owns validation and destructive-action authorization.
providers: Wrap related nested modal workflows in ModalProvider to share the two-layer stack.
accessibility: Supply a title on DialogContent, or compose DialogTitle for a custom heading; use DialogDescription for supporting copy.
Dialog.example: <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}><DialogContent title="Discard changes?"><Button onClick={discard}>Discard changes</Button></DialogContent></Dialog>

useWhen: Feedback about the result of an action.
avoidWhen: Use Banner for persistent regional notices and field APIs for validation.
composition: Call useToast().createToast(...) from inside ToastProvider; default duration is five seconds, Infinity permits manual dismissal.

useWhen: Type to search or create options.
avoidWhen: Use Select for a known option list.

useWhen: Active AI generation, reasoning, or tool use.
avoidWhen: Use Spinner for routine saves, fetches, or refreshes, including chat history.
accessibility: Name the work; show elapsed time only for longer waits.

avoidWhen: Use ThinkingState for labeled AI work or Spinner for routine loading.
accessibility: Announce status on the surrounding control or region.

avoidWhen: Use ThinkingState for AI work, Skeleton for known content shapes, or ProgressBar for measurable completion.

useWhen: A page-level failure or not-found state needs an explanation and optional recovery action.
avoidWhen: Use field APIs for validation, Banner for regional notices, or ErrorBoundary to catch rendering failures.
composition: Supply title and message; pass action for a supported retry or backTo for navigation. The host owns retry behavior and loading state.
accessibility: Explain what happened and what the user can do next; label recovery actions clearly.
ErrorState.example: <ErrorState title="Could not load results" message="Try again to reload the page." action={<Button onClick={retry}>Try again</Button>} />
